prerequisites: elasticity and strength (stress and strain analysis)
basics of design (creation of drawing documentation)

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze and design basic machine components used to transmit power and rotary motion, such as gears, shaft clutches, brakes and flywheels.
Knowledge of the principle, calculation and use of basic transmission mechanisms.
Ability to apply the acquired knowledge in the design of new machines and devices.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to gears. Types of gears and terminology.
Fundamentals of the theory of spur gears. Manufacturing and standardization of gears.
Straight and helical spur gears. Gear mechanisms.
Failures of gears. Lubrication of gears. Calculation of bending stress in the tooth root. Calculation of contact stress.
Strength analysis of straight and helical spur gears.
Solution of an individual semester project according to the assignment of the teacher.
assessment_rules: The course is completed by taking an exam after receiving credit. To receive credit, students must actively participate during the semester and earn at least 50 points out of 100 on assigned tasks. The exam evaluates comprehensive mastery of the subject matter and the ability to apply knowledge independently and creatively, requiring at least 50 points out of 100. The exam consists of a mandatory written part (four tasks) and a voluntary oral part.
